query:
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.state, (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM email
                    WHERE task_id = t.id AND state = 'generating'
                ) AS remaining, (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM email
                    WHERE task_id = t.id AND model IS NOT NULL
                    AND state NOT IN ('generating', 'generation_failed',
                        'canceled')
                ) AS generated, (
                    SELECT count(*)
                    FROM email
                    WHERE task_id = t.id AND state = 'generation_failed'
                ) AS failed
                FROM task t
                WHERE t.id = ?
